pairs: Eliseus autem locutus est ad mulierem cujus vivere fecerat filium,
Now Elisha spoke to the woman, whose son he had caused to live,
dicens: Surge,
saying: “Rise up.
vade tu et domus tua,
Go, you and your household,
et peregrinare ubicumque repereris:
and sojourn in whatever place you can find.
vocavit enim Dominus famem,
For the Lord has called forth a famine,
et veniet super terram septem annis.
and it shall overwhelm the land for seven years.”
Quæ surrexit,
And she rose up,
et fecit juxta verbum hominis Dei:
and she acted in accord with the word of the man of God.
et vadens cum domo sua,
And going with her household,
peregrinata est in terra Philisthiim diebus multis.
she sojourned in the land of the Philistines for many days.
Cumque finiti essent anni septem,
And when the seven years had ended,
reversa est mulier de terra Philisthiim:
the woman returned from the land of the Philistines.
et egressa est ut interpellaret regem pro domo sua,
And she departed,
et pro agris suis.
so that she might petition the king on behalf of her house and on behalf of her fields.
Rex autem loquebatur cum Giezi puero viri Dei,
Now the king was speaking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God,
dicens:
saying,
Narra mihi omnia magnalia quæ fecit Eliseus.
“Describe for me all the great deeds that Elisha has done.”
Cumque ille narraret regi quomodo mortuum suscitasset,
And as he was describing for the king the manner in which he had raised the dead,
apparuit mulier cujus vivificaverat filium,
the woman appeared, whose son he had restored to life,
clamans ad regem pro domo sua, et pro agris suis. Dixitque Giezi:
crying out to the king on behalf of her house and on behalf of her fields.
Domine mi rex,
And Gehazi said,
hæc est mulier,
“My lord the king,
et hic est filius ejus quem suscitavit Eliseus.
this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha raised up.”
Et interrogavit rex mulierem:
And the king questioned the woman.
quæ narravit ei.
And she explained it to him.
Deditque ei rex eunuchum unum,
And the king appointed a eunuch to her,
dicens:
saying,
Restitue ei omnia quæ sua sunt,
“Restore to her all that is hers,
et universos reditus agrorum,
with all the proceeds of the fields,
a die qua reliquit terram usque ad præsens.
from the day that she left the land until the present.”
Venit quoque Eliseus Damascum,
Also, Elisha arrived in Damascus,
et Benadad rex Syriæ ægrotabat:
and Benhadad, the king of Syria, was ill.
nuntiaveruntque ei,
And they reported to him,
dicentes: Venit vir Dei huc.
saying, “The man of God has arrived here.”
Et ait rex ad Hazaël:
And the king said to Hazael:
Tolle tecum munera,
“Take with you gifts.
et vade in occursum viri Dei,
And go to meet the man of God.
et consule Dominum per eum,
And consult the Lord through him,
dicens:
saying:
Si evadere potero de infirmitate mea hac?
‘Will I be able to escape from this, my infirmity?’”
Ivit igitur Hazaël in occursum ejus,
And so, Hazael went to meet him, having with him gifts,
habens secum munera,
and all the goods of Damascus,
et omnia bona Damasci,
the burdens of forty camels.
onera quadraginta camelorum.
And when he had stood before him,
Cumque stetisset coram eo,
he said: “Your son, Benhadad,
ait: Filius tuus Benadad rex Syriæ misit me ad te,
the king of Syria, sent me to you,
dicens:
saying:
Si sanari potero de infirmitate mea hac?
‘Will I be able to be healed from this, my infirmity?’”
Dixitque ei Eliseus:
And Elisha said to him: “Go,
Vade,
tell him:
dic ei: Sanaberis:
‘You will be healed.’
porro ostendit mihi Dominus quia morte morietur.
But the Lord has revealed to me that, dying he shall die.”
Stetique cum eo,
And he stood beside him,
et conturbatus est usque ad suffusionem vultus:
and he was so troubled that his face became flushed.
flevitque vir Dei.
And the man of God wept.
Cui Hazaël ait:
And Hazael said to him,
Quare dominus meus flet?
“Why is my lord weeping?”
At ille dixit:
And he said:
Quia scio quæ facturus sis filiis Israël mala.
“Because I know the evil that you will do to the sons of Israel.
Civitates eorum munitas igne succendes,
Their fortified cities you will burn with fire.
et juvenes eorum interficies gladio,
And their young men you will kill with the sword.
et parvulos eorum elides,
And you will destroy their little ones,
et prægnantes divides.
and tear open the pregnant women.”
Dixitque Hazaël:
And Hazael said,
Quid enim sum servus tuus canis,
“But what am I, your servant, a dog,
ut faciam rem istam magnam?
that I would do this great thing?”
Et ait Eliseus:
And Elisha said,
Ostendit mihi Dominus te regem Syriæ fore.
“The Lord has revealed to me that you will be the king of Syria.”
Qui cum recessisset ab Eliseo,
And when he had departed from Elisha,
venit ad dominum suum.
he went to his lord,
Qui ait ei:
who said to him,
Quid dixit tibi Eliseus?
“What did Elisha say to you?”
At ille respondit:
And he responded:
Dixit mihi:
“He said to me,
Recipies sanitatem.
‘You shall receive health.’”
Cumque venisset dies altera,
And when the next day had arrived,
tulit stragulum,
he took a small covering,
et infudit aquam,
and poured water on it,
et expandit super faciem ejus:
and he spread it over his face.
quo mortuo,
And when he died,
regnavit Hazaël pro eo.
Hazael reigned in his place.
Anno quinto Joram filii Achab regis Israël,
In the fifth year of Joram, the son of Ahab, the king of Israel,
et Josaphat regis Juda,
and of Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah:
regnavit Joram filius Josaphat rex Juda.
Jehoram, the son of Jehoshaphat, reigned as the king of Judah.
Triginta duorum annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset,
He was thirty-two years old when he had begun to reign,
et octo annis regnavit in Jerusalem.
and he reigned for eight years in Jerusalem.
Ambulavitque in viis regum Israël,
And he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel,
sicut ambulaverat domus Achab:
just as the house of Ahab had walked.
filia enim Achab erat uxor ejus:
For the daughter of Ahab was his wife.
et fecit quod malum est in conspectu Domini.
And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord.
Noluit autem Dominus disperdere Judam,
But the Lord was not willing to destroy Judah,
propter David servum suum,
because of David, his servant,
sicut promiserat ei,
just as he had promised him,
ut daret illi lucernam, et filiis ejus cunctis diebus.
so that he might grant a light to him and to his sons, for all days.
In diebus ejus recessit Edom ne esset sub Juda,
In his days, Idumea drew apart, so as not to be under Judah,
et constituit sibi regem.
and they appointed a king for themselves.
Venitque Joram Seira,
And so, Jehoram went to Zair,
et omnes currus cum eo:
and all the chariots with him.
et surrexit nocte,
And he rose up in the night,
percussitque Idumæos qui eum circumdederant,
and he struck down the Idumeans who had surrounded him,
et principes curruum: populus autem fugit in tabernacula sua.
and the leaders of the chariots. But the people fled to their tents.
Recessit ergo Edom ne esset sub Juda,
And Idumea drew apart, so as not to be under Judah,
usque ad diem hanc.
even to this day.
Tunc recessit et Lobna in tempore illo.
Then Libnah also drew apart, at the same time.
Reliqua autem sermonum Joram,
Now the rest of the words of Jehoram,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
Et dormivit Joram cum patribus suis,
And Jehoram slept with his fathers,
sepultusque est cum eis in civitate David,
and he was buried with them in the city of David.
et regnavit Ochozias filius ejus pro eo.
And Ahaziah, his son, reigned in his place.
Anno duodecimo Joram filii Achab regis Israël regnavit Ochozias filius Joram regis Judæ.
In the twelfth year of Joram, the son of Ahab, the king of Israel: Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, the king of Judah, reigned.
Viginti duorum annorum erat Ochozias cum regnare cœpisset,
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he had begun to reign,
et uno anno regnavit in Jerusalem:
and he reigned for one year in Jerusalem.
nomen matris ejus Athalia filia Amri regis Israël.
The name of his mother was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri, the king of Israel.
Et ambulavit in viis domus Achab:
And he walked in the ways of the house of Ahab.
et fecit quod malum est coram Domino,
And he did what is evil before the Lord,
sicut domus Achab:
just as the house of Ahab did.
gener enim domus Achab fuit.
For he was the son-in-law of the house of Ahab.
Abiit quoque cum Joram filio Achab ad præliandum contra Hazaël regem Syriæ in Ramoth Galaad, et vulneraverunt Syri Joram.
Also, he went with Joram, the son of Ahab, in order to fight against Hazael, the king of Syria, at Ramoth Gilead. And the Syrians had wounded Joram.

Qui reversus est ut curaretur in Jezrahel, quia vulneraverant eum Syri in Ramoth præliantem contra Hazaël regem Syriæ. Porro Ochozias filius Joram rex Juda descendit invisere Joram filium Achab in Jezrahel, quia ægrotabat ibi.

And he turned back, so that he might be cured at Jezreel. For the Syrians had wounded him at Ramoth, fighting against Hazael, the king of Syria. Then Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, the king of Judah, descended to visit Joram, the son of Ahab, at Jezreel, because he was sick there.
